note: Set A binds values to the correct components and properties throughout, with only three truncated values ("TIERRA S" twice and "PORCELA"). Set B makes more serious errors: it misreads the faucet model as SP-L-65014LF-PC and the shower head model as 2655, truncates SK's manufacturer to "FR" and description to "SI", and misbinds F1's description as "FA" when F1 is a BED. Both sets cover similar ground, but A is more accurate and complete on equipment, plumbing, finish and millwork data.
